reason: I already ask Claude what to do and then place the trades myself, and that works because I'm the one pushing the button. A cartoon pet moving my real money, with an unnamed broker and no price yet, isn't something I'd sign up for, even a waitlist.
objection: If the agent makes a bad trade inside the limits I set, who eats the loss? Me, MyLiquid, or the broker partner nobody has named yet? A record I can download doesn't help me get my money back.
would_change_my_mind: A named, licensed broker that holds my account with SIPC coverage, plus a written plain-English answer on who is liable when the agent loses money, and a few months of me watching it on the demo account before any real money goes in.
